brandConfig.heading: Brand configuration
brandConfig.description: Configure your brand context for Blog Posts generation. These values are used as input to the content generation process.

placeholders.toneOfVoice: How the brand communicates (e.g. formal, casual, inspirational). Use 'Scrape store' to auto-generate from your content.
placeholders.benchmarks: Competitor or reference brands (e.g. Gisou, Glossier), one per line
placeholders.editorialGuidelines: Content architecture, tone rules, structure guidelines
placeholders.formatRecommendations: HTML structure, summary guidelines (e.g. Resumo HTML: 150–160 chars), content length

scrapeStore.heading: Scrape store
scrapeStore.description: Use "Scrape store" to analyze your shop content and auto-generate tone of voice. Requires the Content Scraper API to be configured.
